2609.02526.title: When Persona Attributes Improve Population Alignment in Large Language Models
2609.02526.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to predict the responses of human participants in survey panels. Towards that goal, persona prompting has recently emerged as a technique to inform and align large pretrained language models. Persona prompting refers to the practice of using short textual descriptions of 'personas' in prompts to steer the LLM's generations. Personas describe individuals through different attributes such as their socio-demographics, attitudes, or behaviors, with the aim of aligning LLMs to produce responses that correlate with the corresponding human responses. Yet, recent work has produced mixed and partly conflicting results of persona prompting without clear patterns of success and failure. Among the few consistent findings is that the selection of persona attributes matters, and that using more attributes does not necessarily lead to better performance. It remains unclear how different attribute selection methods perform and how to choose among them. In this paper, we propose that observed human response variation of a survey question is a potential explanation for the mixed performance observed so far. In addition, we compare the performance of persona prompting associated with different methods for selecting persona attributes. We evaluate these methods on four different (general) social surveys across two countries, six LLMs, and twenty prediction tasks per survey. Our work helps to identify when persona prompting can be expected to be useful in survey prediction tasks, and provides new insights on the effectiveness of different attribute selection methods for LLM-based survey prediction using persona prompting.
2609.02526.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地被用來預測人類參與者在調查小組中的反應。<lb/>為了達成這一目標，角色提示最近出現作為一種技術，用於告知和調整大型預訓練語言模型。<lb/>角色提示是指在提示中使用「角色」的簡短文本描述，以引導LLM的生成。<lb/>角色通過不同的屬性來描述個體，例如他們的社會人口統計、態度或行為，旨在使LLM產生與相應人類反應相關的回應。<lb/>然而，最近的研究產生了混合且部分相互矛盾的角色提示結果，沒有明確的成功和失敗模式。<lb/>在少數一致的發現中，角色屬性的選擇是重要的，並且使用更多屬性不一定會導致更好的表現。<lb/>目前尚不清楚不同的屬性選擇方法的表現如何，以及如何在它們之間進行選擇。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出調查問題的觀察到的人類反應變異可能是迄今為止觀察到的混合表現的潛在解釋。<lb/>此外，我們比較了與不同角色屬性選擇方法相關的角色提示的表現。<lb/>我們在兩個國家的四個不同（一般）社會調查中評估這些方法，涉及六個LLM和每個調查的二十個預測任務。<lb/>我們的工作有助於識別在調查預測任務中何時可以期待角色提示的有效性，並提供有關使用角色提示的LLM基礎調查預測的不同屬性選擇方法的有效性的新見解。
